method: Starting from R0_T2 probabilities, compute the minimum adjacent gap in sorted PRE scores. Shrink the full probability vector toward uniform by lambda = alpha * exp(-min_gap/tau).
development_worlds: Only structural families already consumed by 11_STRUCTURAL_FALSIFICATION_RESULT.json; no new fresh worlds and no real outcomes.
tradeoff: The minimax-selected shrinkage reduced worst-case regret on consumed structural worlds but increased mean regret materially. Therefore it is not accepted as a successor lead; it is only a development clue that local ambiguity handling can buy tail robustness at an average-performance cost.
next_research: Develop a more selective local-only rank-robust component that does not globally shrink all entrant probabilities when only one adjacent pair is ambiguous.
